title: SQL Mission 5: Filter Early In CTE

initialState.content:
-- Finance team needs 2025 total spend per customer.
-- Only completed orders count.
--
-- Rules:
--   1. Filter in CTE (status + date)
--   2. Aggregate in outer query
--   3. Sort by total_spend descending
--
-- Table: orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status, total_amount)

WITH filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    total_amount
  FROM orders
  WHERE
    -- TODO: status = 'completed'
    -- TODO: order_date >= '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  -- TODO: SUM + alias
FROM filtered_orders
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY total_spend DESC;
